sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A bounded piece of document text used as addressable evidence.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Instead of pointing to an entire textbook, point to the relevant passage.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: The paragraph containing the Joule Studio description becomes a retrievable evidence unit.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Chunks belong to an immutable DocumentVersion and are generated under a versioned chunking contract.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Small evidence units make retrieval and citations more precise.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: F6 tracks hard chunk-bound correctness. A configured limit is not proof that every input obeys it.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
